archetypes.name: dyn-bug-prefix-contract
archetypes.rationale: Generated titles, strip consumers, and Tier B rejection must stay aligned on [BUG] vs legacy [Bug].
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect title generation in _report.py and design_terminal.py for title_match.BUG_PREFIX usage. Confirm removeprefix still accepts historical [Bug], the shell Tier B regex rejects both forms, and fixtures assert canonical generation without regressing legacy rejection. Fail if any generation site still hardcodes mixed-case [Bug]. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
